dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: A preliminary survey must be performed before delving into a domain. But here... hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: #If you don't mind resting here for while more, I might be able to go and gather some useful intelligence, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I'm nowhere near as good in combat as the others... But I wanna make sure I do my part!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Exploring this domain is no easy task, but please don't worry — I won't let everyone down!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: The Grand Master once told me that so long as I play to my strengths and contribute to the team, I'm doing my duty.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I'll do my best. And I'm sure everyone else will do their part, too!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Mondstadt has changed so much in the short time I've been gone...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Oh — I don't mean that I don't like the way things are now. I guess I just get a little nostalgic for the days I spent with the Grand Master's expedition sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I wonder where they're all up to now? And whether they need any new maps...
